hooks.command: mise -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" exec -- sh -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path"); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tools/*.ts) npx biome format --write "$f" ;; esac' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mise -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" exec -- node_modules/.bin/biome format --write src tools >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
